commits.headline: docs: ask contributors to batch matches into one pull request with clustered commits
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: One open match pull request per contributor, commits of 10+ related functions where possible, clusters of 10+ prioritised, about 30+ functions before review, and the generated reports and maps regenerated once in the last commit. Maintainers merge and refresh the reports by hand once per round, so a pull request per small set of matches costs time and conflicts.
